You need your own copy of Medal of Honor: Allied Assault. Download its Windows installer from GOG (the .exe and the .bin files) and import it here: the app extracts the game by itself.
Lower is faster and uses less battery; the picture is scaled to the screen.
Up to 120 on 120 Hz screens. Lower saves battery.
How fast the right stick turns.
Select an action and press the button you want for it. A button already in use swaps with it.
Quick save: objectives + previous weapon. Quick load: objectives + next weapon.

The app needs the files of your copy of the game. The simplest way: download the game\'s Windows installer from GOG (the setup_….exe and the .bin files that come with it), choose “Import from files” and select all of them: the app extracts the game right here. You can also import the folder of the installed game (or a .zip of it). Only the data folders are copied.
No game files found in that folder. Pick the folder that holds “main”.

Mods are .pk3 files (or a .zip holding them, or a .zip of game files) that change or add to the game: translations, textures, sounds, maps. They are loaded over the game\'s own files, in alphabetical order.
No mods installed for this game.
Mods made by others may not work with OpenMoHAA. Mods that need Windows programs (.exe, .dll) can\'t be used.
Remove %1$s? It is deleted from the app.
%1$d mod(s) installed. They are used the next time the game starts.
Nothing was installed. Choose .pk3 or .zip mod files: a .zip must hold .pk3 files or game folders (global, textures, sound, maps…).
The campaign Play starts: Allied Assault, Spearhead or Breakthrough (if installed).
No game files in that file. It must hold the game\'s folder, or its “main” folder.
That kind of file can\'t be imported. Choose the GOG installer (its .exe and .bin files) or a .zip of the game\'s folder.
Choose the installer\'s .exe file too, along with the .bin files.
Parts of the installer are missing. Choose the .exe and all the .bin files that came with it (for example setup_…-1.bin and setup_…-2.bin).
Not enough free space: %1$s are needed.
Reload the rifle at any time
In the original game, the M1 Garand only reloads when its clip is empty. On, it reloads like the other weapons (campaign).
